title: Drone Strike Map place hit / Russian alert region
description: Published BY bridges/vendors/dronestrikemap/dronestrikemap_bridge.py every DSM_POLL_S: one marker per place hit per day (type strike), and one polygon per Russian region that is red (active air-raid alert) or yellow (a place hit today or yesterday) on top of the orange regions dangausakis draws (type air_alert_zone). Data: Drone Strike Map (dronestrikemap.com, CC BY 4.0), reporting by the outlets named in remarks. The position of a strike is the place, not the impact point. A record that leaves the site is retracted with a one-shot {uid, type, _delete: true} tombstone.

uid.description: DSM-<date>-<country>-<place> for a strike; DSM-REGION-<region id>[-p<n>] for a zone.

callsign.description: A strike: '<place> hit <dd Mon> (<confidence>)', plus ' - occupied' in Russian-held Ukraine. The topic's side is the striker's: friendly = a place in Russia or Russian-held Ukraine (a Ukrainian strike), hostile = a place in Ukraine (a Russian strike).

remarks.description: Summary, weapons, outlets and the credit line.
